scope: Completed configurations in MODEL_COMPARISON_2026-09-24.zh-CN.md. This supplement does not alter frozen token counts, grades or the posthoc preference score.
source_kind: authenticated read-only quota consumption logs for the existing local test API key; no model inference calls

display_conversion.limitation: Account credit consumption in the platform display currency, not a recharge/payment invoice. Historical display settings, actual recharge discounts, taxes and cash exchange rates are not verified.

identification_limit: The old traces do not retain provider billing request IDs. Matching uses a unique consecutive model-specific block, logical-request counts and aggregate tokens; it is not a cryptographic per-request linkage. Unlogged charges/refunds cannot be ruled out.
privacy: Public evidence contains aggregates only; no API key, user/account/token identifiers, IP addresses, request IDs, raw response bodies or raw reasoning. Local source records remain ignored.
